definitions.gloss: the other day, a few days ago, recently
definitions.explanation: A day in the recent past, typically within the last week or two.

examples.japanese: {先日|せんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありがとうございました→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for the other day.

examples.japanese: {先日|せんじつ}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}した→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦です→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧...
examples.english: Regarding the matter we discussed on the phone the other day...

examples.japanese: {先日|せんじつ}⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会|あ}いました→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into you by chance at the station the other day.

examples.japanese: {先日|せんじつ}⟦お{送|おく}りした→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{届|とど}きましたでしょうか→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Did you receive the documents I sent the other day?

examples.japanese: {先日|せんじつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}しましょう→確認する：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: Let's reconfirm this afternoon what was decided at the meeting the other day.

notes:
{先日|せんじつ} is a polite way to refer to a recent day.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先日|せんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありがとうございました→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧ (Thank you for the other day)
- {先日|せんじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}しました→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧ (Sorry about the other day)
- {先日|せんじつ}⟦お{話|はな}しした→話す：00467_hanasu⟧... (As I mentioned the other day...)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先日|せんじつ}: the other day (polite/formal)
- ⟦この{間|あいだ}→この間：01257_konoaida⟧/⟦この{前|まえ}→この前：25259_konomae⟧: the other day (casual)
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: a few days ago (neutral)
